how: Participants call for specific marks, inscription work, and later repairs.
A participant proposes a mark and reports placing its initial gold pixel independently of others joining.
A bare seconding accepts the initial-placement proposal as a direct reply.
The starting-pixel proposal receives a bare acceptance without a request for anything in return.
A question about which subreddit made the figure receives an answer attributing contributions to several communities.
A challenge about whether a word is a spoiler receives an explanation of the lore it would disclose.
Explanation of the inscription's meaning becomes an argument over what newcomers should encounter first.
A participant concedes resistance to the inscription change and leaves while also naming eating and laundry.
Departure amid a dispute can have mixed stated motives and does not independently establish emotional strain as its cause.
Eating and laundry explicitly constrain further participation in the inscription effort.
A comparison of membership explains attributed credit without establishing inadequate hands or space for the intended work.
Comparative membership and the separately announced location change do not establish shortage causing relocation.
Proposing a figure and calling for its construction coincide in one starter's appeal.
Participants report initial pixel work, a wrong-colour contribution, and a completed outline.
Participants ask for a pixel template and circulate coordinates with a target image.
Reported work before arrival at the thread leaves recruitment as the cause of those contributions unestablished.
Participants propose incompatible inscriptions and disagree about retaining or replacing the existing word.
Participants enact design disagreements through letter changes that others repeatedly reverse.
A posted specification settles the design only where competing placers accept it rather than restoring another version.
Improvisation coexists with explicit thread coordination and an unfulfilled request for moderator arbitration.
Disclaiming organization limits claims about collective authority without eliminating visible task coordination.
Explicit coordination in the thread does not establish a move to chat or rule out other unrecorded planning.
Public coordination replies establish no concealed plan or infiltration of another venue.
Repeating a rumor about unspecified pieces establishes no local operator or actual placement automation.
Repair reports and a bot rumor do not demonstrate adoption of automation because upkeep exceeded available hands.
Repeating a bot explanation while reporting persistence is observable talk distinct from operating placement automation.
The cutoff-time border promise reports no technical fault, timer problem, or site workaround.
Participants maintain the figure and label through reported work, persistence checks, and explicit repair requests.
A completed outline precedes a repair call explicitly identifying damaged features of the standing figure.
A helper identifies a wrong-colour pixel as their own contribution.
The speaker reports repeated eye correction being reversed by people described as well-meaning defenders.
The speaker attributes eye reversions to defenders without identifying their accounts or demonstrating their knowledge.
The failed-communication account requires evidence of keeper ignorance because participants explicitly defend incompatible inscription outcomes.
Explicit preference for retaining an existing inscription can persist alongside circulation of a competing plan.
A loss report and name correction support attributed blame but verify perpetrator identity only with additional evidence.
A suggested construction-site move is refused by invoking an existing agreement and progress already made.
Participants invoke a neighbour agreement and directly request and accept a protective shared border.
Neighbour negotiation can support construction before a maintenance crisis and need not be caused by neighbours eroding the work.
An existing neighbour agreement and accumulated progress explicitly justify retaining a construction site when another location is proposed.
The announced location change identifies no prior erasure and cannot be explained by the smaller attempt's later loss.
A visitor explicitly claims to represent related communities while carrying a protective border proposal.
A respondent qualifies the predicted restraint of fellow placers by disclaiming organization and acknowledging internal conflict.
The disclaimer accompanies acceptance of proposed terms within the stated bound rather than demonstrating a later dispute caused by an existing agreement.
A respondent conditionally promises to spare the neighbour's logo if the figure's head is left alone.
A protective border request receives a conditional restraint promise without establishing room-wide compliance.
A neighbour offers spare pixels while requesting protection and a respondent promises squares for a shared border.
Border talk supports offered help here but demonstrates completed reciprocal work only with evidence of implementation.
Neighbour offers do not establish exhaustion of local hands causing outside recruitment.
A qualified individual's promise does not establish universal authority or implementation after placement has closed.
Reported contributions from several communities do not establish a coalition or mutual obligations.
The reported safe-site agreement does not establish a host's rule over guest builders.
Cheering another community does not itself establish membership in both rooms at a border or contest.
Conflicting inscription preferences do not establish an argument about the fairness of covering others' work.
Established fandom language supplies jokes and recognition around the image and its associated work.
Competing inscriptions are recast as rival houses in a new joke about the canvas struggle.
Participants make image-specific and thread-specific jokes using lore, altered spelling, and a bot preview.
Current background work and inscription reversions do not establish that the quarrel predates the canvas.
Neither the encroachment proposal nor the rhetorical war call establishes an antecedent tie naming the attacked rival.
Arguments around the shared image extend into contrasting judgments about acceptable lore topics and ways related subreddits have fun.
Disputing permissible lore questions does not establish rejection of slurs, hate symbols, or offensive canvas taunts.
Rhetorical house factions do not establish a new subreddit or chat founded for the canvas.
Describing the canvas as full of memes does not establish a host-specific April Fools takeover or licence.
Requesting design arbitration by moderators establishes no host containment or removal of canvas talk.
Recruitment and a design-arbitration request do not establish a canvas flood causing host containment.
Inscription resistance establishes no attack on the room's mark motivated by objection to canvas posts.
Participants mark completion through announcements, celebration, thanks, and an in-world drink.
Reporting the outline finished precedes explicit celebration while the adjoining inscription remains contested.
Participants dispute and distribute credit among related communities rather than establish sole local authorship.
Celebratory ownership and congratulations support attributed participation but exclusive authorship requires additional evidence.
A viewer explicitly says encountering the figure prompted a visit to thank the room.
An image-prompted visit need not establish first-time membership, subscriber growth, or incorporation into ordinary room activity.
Admiration of a fictional figure establishes no attempt to obtain acknowledgement from creators, companies, teams, or press.
A participant records that the smaller attempt was covered and another corrects the wording of its attribution.
An edited completion announcement links a record of the face without establishing a final settled inscription.
Celebration and linked records do not establish that celebration caused preservation activity.
After placement ends a visitor clarifies that the admired art was not their community's work.
Post-close authorship clarification supports correction of the event account without establishing cleanup of a shared canvas copy.
Later lore repetition and subreddit discussion establish no successor canvas or retained collective purpose.
An outcome record followed by lore discussion does not establish movement toward a durable new purpose.
A participant proposes placing the mark in the middle of another game's logo.
An exasperated edited comment voices a war call without establishing a coordinated attack's execution.
The mark proposal directly receives a suggestion to place it over another logo.
A rhetorical war call and criticism of lore subreddits do not establish continued contention against an identified canvas opponent.
The encroachment suggestion receives an enthusiastic template request rather than a recorded refusal or apology.
No passage establishes the later neighbour agreement as a response to the earlier encroachment suggestion.
The rhetorical war call establishes no attack causing continued contention with a rival room.
Maintenance and reports of shared contributions establish no defense-induced coalition formation.

statement: pointing to another room without an explained relation
how: The bare link establishes pointing but leaves help, alliance, attack, and negotiation unresolved beneath a deleted parent.
